reasoning: The tomato leaf shows numerous small (1-2mm) dark brown to black spots scattered uniformly across the surface with characteristic yellow/chlorotic halos surrounding many spots. This is the classic presentation of Bacterial Speck of Tomato caused by Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato. The spots are too small and uniformly dark for Septoria (which has lighter centers), too numerous and small for Early Blight (which forms target-ring lesions), and the distribution pattern is consistent with bacterial speck infection.
